name: Tomose Runa
source:
Runa is a first-year student who belongs to the drama club.
She is Ritsuki's little sister who is the same age as him.

She has previously had experience as a child actress. She proudly believes that she has high "performance skill."

Her ego is high, and she is full of self-esteem.
